title.zh: Base 完成第三次主网升级 Cobalt
title.en: Base Completes Third Mainnet Upgrade Cobalt

current_state.zh: Base 已完成第三次主网升级 Cobalt，该升级包含条件门控的 Validity Transactions、三项新的 B20 代币标准功能，以及针对 B20 的可选行政余额扣押规则（seizeWithMemo）。
current_state.en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, which includes condition-gated Validity Transactions, three new B20 token-standard features, and an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule (seizeWithMemo) for B20 tokens.

updates.title_zh: 【Base 完成 Cobalt 升级，新增条件交易并扩展了 B20 资产功能】
updates.title_en: 【Base 完成 Cobalt 升级，新增条件交易并扩展了 B20 资产功能】
updates.what_changed_zh: Base完成第三次主网升级Cobalt，新增条件门控的有效性交易和三项B20代币标准功能，并规划了迈向200毫秒出块时间、原生智能账户和Gas代付的路线图。
updates.what_changed_en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.

updates.current_state_en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.

updates.title_zh: Base的Cobalt升级新增一条影响代币余额的规则
updates.title_en: Base’s Cobalt upgrade adds another rule to affect token balances
updates.what_changed_zh: Cobalt 升级为 B20 代币引入可选的行政余额扣押规则（seizeWithMemo），要求发行方配置资格、SEIZE_ROLE 授权，并单独设置接收方策略，同时保留代币供应量，原有 burnBlocked 被弃用但仍可调用。
updates.what_changed_en: The Cobalt upgrade introduces an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule (seizeWithMemo) for B20 tokens, requiring issuer eligibility configuration, SEIZE_ROLE authorization, and a separate recipient policy, while preserving token supply and keeping burnBlocked deprecated but callable.
updates.current_state_zh: Base 已完成第三次主网升级 Cobalt，该升级包含条件门控的 Validity Transactions、三项新的 B20 代币标准功能，以及针对 B20 的可选行政余额扣押规则（seizeWithMemo）。
updates.current_state_en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, which includes condition-gated Validity Transactions, three new B20 token-standard features, and an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule (seizeWithMemo) for B20 tokens.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Base's Cobalt upgrade introduces an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule for B20 tokens, kept separate from ordinary transfer restrictions and requiring specific issuer eligibility and authorized roles.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Base's Cobalt upgrade introduces an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule for B20 tokens, kept separate from ordinary transfer restrictions and requiring specific issuer eligibility and authorized roles.
